nodes.label: Excel Import Module
nodes.role: Generate the reference-shaped official workbook and parse reference, minimal, detailed-friendly and legacy keyed workbook formats.
constraints: Official workbook physically contains 使い方/入力/共通データ; 使い方 is hidden and the other two are visible.
Official 入力 exposes exactly 8 columns: テスト項目（必須）/確認項目（必須）/操作（必須）/確認観点・期待結果（必須）/対象・確認箇所（任意）/優先度（任意）/テストデータ（任意）/タグ（任意）.
Official 共通データ exposes exactly 6 columns: テスト項目（必須）/項目名（必須）/値（任意）/メモ（任意）/データ名（任意）/説明（任意）.
Required and optional columns use the reference blue/orange visual grouping; priority uses 高/中/低 list validation.
Friendly parser also accepts the previous four/three-column minimal workbook and fourteen/six-column detailed-friendly workbook.

nodes.label: Excel Template Presentation
nodes.role: Decorate the reference-shaped official workbook with thin grids, actual example rows and a hidden guide sheet.
constraints: Input rows 2-3 and common-data row 2 are real example cells.
Input row 3 keeps test/case-name cells truly blank to demonstrate continuation rows.
The 使い方 sheet is retained in the workbook but hidden.
The guide instructs users to overwrite or delete the examples before upload.
